story.fullStory:
Gucci Mane's "Wasted" reached #36 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Wasted" is the official first single from Gucci Mane's sixth studio album The State vs.

The song peaked at #36 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Wasted was released in 2009.
